claim: One portable NeuroArxiv owner preserves strict novelty gates, real arXiv fetching, per-paper evidence isolation, and a single cited architecture recommendation across Hermes, Codex, and OMP.

portable_behavior_migrated: sequential arXiv export API fetching with thin-result handling
one isolated worker per paper with cross-paper contamination rejection
single actionable convergence path with cited risks and alternates
OMP task batch adapter alongside Codex task and Hermes delegate_task
native_behavior_retained: Codex and OMP use their native task tools
each host uses its native raw URL reader
discarded: the upstream companion CLI, Claude Agent SDK, hooks, plugins, and package scripts
unsupported claims that arXiv abstracts are final authority

verification.arxiv_api: live export API returned an id, title, full abstract, authors, date, and links
verification.portable_invariants: task/delegate routing and fail-closed isolation assertions passed

limits: The full 12-20-paper fan-out was not rerun for structural consolidation. OMP task semantics are official-source verified; the skill stops rather than simulating isolation when a runtime does not expose isolated workers.
